scope: Separate concept-endpoint and bounded junction-graph scope for the canonical v2 working increment. This ledger does not expand or replace the 42-element B.5 matrix.

separate_historical_file_reopen.scope: Historical file behavior before verified Site24 deployment; not current standalone acceptance or placement-file reopen.

source.publication: The Open Group C260, ArchiMate 4 Specification, April 2026
source.method: Locators and original technical analysis relayed from independently inspected, hash-verified supplied PDF and acceptance oracle. This ledger author has not independently inspected the PDF.
source.boundary: No PDF prose, images, normative artwork or source document redistributed. No whole-model conformance, certification, endorsement or licence interpretation is claimed.

table_interpretation.qualification: Concept evidence letters are normalized family-code sets, not a verbatim B.5 cell or an uppercase/direct versus lowercase/derived classification.

endpoint_dispositions.controls: Reverse orientations and Product do not inherit these permissions from composite status.

endpoint_dispositions.qualification: Includes Association. A relationship used as one endpoint is distinct from a relationship with two relationship endpoints.
Require a possible ordinary-element source for that family, except the specific unqualified Grouping-to-Junction cell.
Require a possible ordinary-element target for that family. Do not transpose the source footnote.

endpoint_dispositions.endpoint: at least one junction, including Relationship/Junction in either orientation

source_qualification.raw_table_fact: B.6 junction cells omit the aggregation/composition code, including the relevant container-to-junction cells.
source_qualification.other_source_fact: Section 5.5.1 discusses aggregation transit and containing aggregation; B.6 introductory wording and section 12.4 provide related containment facts.
source_qualification.disposition: UNKNOWN for Aggregation or Composition at ANY junction endpoint. Separate from the eight ordinary-element B.5 UNKNOWNs.
source_qualification.relationship_junction_refinement: The independent oracle supersedes the earlier design sentence classifying every non-association Relationship/Junction family negative; aggregation/composition are conservatively UNKNOWN in both orientations.
source_qualification.resolution: Require scoped authoritative clarification, applicable erratum or verified replacement specification explicitly settling the affected endpoint cases; independently review and record publication, hash and exact locators. No guessed precedence rule or blanket default.

checks: At least two distinct transit relationship IDs; at least one incoming and one outgoing transit relationship
Same base family, with separate unresolved mixed-qualifier assessment
All reachable terminal-concept pairs through same-family junction chains, including derived B.5 allowances
Multiplicity attribute applicability at each junction-attached end
Terminal coverage, cycle-scope and bounded analysis completeness
junction_graph.relationship_terminal_policy: A relationship endpoint is a terminal concept. Do not expand its own endpoints.
junction_graph.container_role: Only explicit junctionRole: container on Aggregation from Grouping/Location/Plateau to a junction receives the checked transit exception. Exclude it from degree, family and traversal, but retain its source-scope UNKNOWN endpoint decision. Invalid declarations do not bypass checks. Composition exception applicability remains UNKNOWN.
junction_graph.family_boundary: Access variants share a base family; DirectedAssociation shares Association. Mixed qualifiers retain UNKNOWN compatibility. Aggregation and Composition remain distinct base families; shared g permission code does not establish mixed-junction compatibility, which remains UNKNOWN.
junction_graph.multiplicity: Any present raw attribute at a junction end, including empty text, fails applicability without deleting it. The opposite end is not excluded by this rule; syntax and real-world instance counts remain separate.
junction_graph.cycle_boundary: Cycle-safe traversal supplies no DAG rule. A junction-only or uncovered terminal-less region is UNKNOWN; cycles with terminal witnesses retain an unassessed cycle-scope diagnostic.
junction_graph.work_boundary: Work-limit exhaustion sets complete false and UNKNOWN coverage. A definite FAIL survives; pending traversal states are not exact unexplored terminal-pair counts.
not_inferred: Runtime execution or inclusive/exclusive choice semantics
local_conventions: Explicit junctionRole container intent disambiguates transit from a containing edge; it is an application annotation, not a new normative field.
Terminal-less/uncovered-region UNKNOWN and work budgets prevent false certification; they do not prohibit cycles.
Identity-only profile/result trust and input isolation are application security safeguards, not ArchiMate model rules.

authority.activation: Original code-owned CURRENT_PROFILE object identity in a genuine registry, never matching IDs or copied metadata.
authority.boundary: Recognizers trust object identity only, without inspecting caller fields. Copies, serialized output, proxies and forged fields cannot gain source authority. Reports are read-only and not persisted.

ordinary_element_regression.unchanged_scope: Product/Plateau to Deliverable/WorkPackage for Aggregation/Composition only; retain prior 21660-decision evidence hash.

independent_oracle.boundary: Independent expected acceptance data, not generated from the implementation. These are fixture inventory counts, not implementation PASS counts. Compact repository fixtures pin these original artifact hashes.

source_review.boundary: Source interpretation only; not implementation, aggregate or browser acceptance.

independent_oracle.coverage_boundary: Bounded oracle, not an exhaustive full-language or element/junction port oracle. Nine positive ordinary-element/junction port cases have selected independent B.5 witnesses. Other blocks cover the enumerated concept combinations only.
